subject: general
question: Which of the following dance forms is performed by Sonal Mansingh?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Bharatanatyam and Odissi.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **Bharatanatyam and Odissi is performed by Sonal Mansingh.**
 
• Bharatanatyam is a south Indian dance form, more specifically speaking, it originated in the state of Tamil Nadu. 
 
 
• And so the dance is often accompanied by classical Tamil songs and music. 
 
• Kathak is a north Indian dance form and it was developed by the nomads who were known as the Kathaks.
 
 
 
• Odissi is one of the Indian classical dance forms which came from the inspiration of Hindu temples in the state of Odisha.
 
 
• This dance form mainly illustrates mythological, religious, and devotional stories, and the dancers present the same.
